dct_alternative_sm: Zelandia comitatus, septemdecim inferioris Germaniae Provinciis annumeratur
dct_description_sm: Arnoldus et Henricus Florentii à Langren fratres sculpserunt.
Tweede titel: Zelandia comitatus, Septemdecim Inferioris Germaniae Provinciis annumeratur...
3 bar scales on map, given in "Scala Miliariu Germanicorum... "Parua," "Mediocria," "Magna."
North oriented toward upper right of sheet.
Decorative border and cartouches, coats of arms, compass rose, rhumb lines, buildings, vegetation, ships.
This copy has inscription in red in lower left.
This copy has watermark at right.
